Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Boise hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 15 Boise hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 3, Super.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, dealbase.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Tripening Hotels at 1. These are the Boise rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Boise hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Holiday Inn Express & Suites Boise Airport by IHG to 14% at Comfort Suites Airport. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
